title: A careful library about living through loss
description: Material with clear descriptions and the freedom to choose a subject without a set pace.

blocks.text: In the review that follows, a person living through a loss values the Bible stories and the connection to their faith. That is grounds for one particular editorial selection, not proof that everyone in grief has the same need.

quote.text: This app has been an incredible tool that has been instrumental in helping me stay connected to God in a time of crushing grief. The Biblical sleep stories have guided me to fleeting rest in the long dark nights

blocks.text: Describe the language and the content of the support

Show the author, the subjects and the character of the guidance before listening. Let people save the recordings that suit them and turn down the rest, without setting a deadline or a compulsory order.

A library like this calls for work with authors and specialists in the field. A personal review describes the peace one person found; it does not allow you to promise a similar result or to replace other support with listening.
